name: omp-tools
description: OMP flexible ask adapter, generate_image with OpenAI (GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst) and Codex modes, and read-only /btw side questions

imageGenerationMode.description: Service and billing for generate_image. openai uses GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst with the openai API key and the API organization's billing; codex uses the ChatGPT/Codex login's image allowance. Applies to new sessions.

svgAuthorModel.description: SVG author for generate_image's OpenAI mode: the OpenAI text model that writes an SVG from the drawn image, billed at that model's token rates. A call's svg.model overrides it. Empty uses gpt-6.1-sol. Applies to new sessions.

sideQuestionModel.description: Model for /btw and Picker btw. Use a role such as @smol or provider/model:level. Empty uses the main model.
